profile_text.body:
Hesai Group, which presents itself as Hesai Technology on its website, describes itself as a global leader in lidar solutions for advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous mobility. The company says its technology enables physical AI across ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, and that it supplies high-performance lidar sensors for automotive, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications.

According to the site, Hesai's lidars provide high-resolution 3D perception for features such as automated emergency braking (AEB) and navigation on autopilot (NOA), and meet standards for L4+ autonomous driving in applications including robotaxis and robobuses. The company states it delivers mass-produced, market-proven lidars to customers in over 40 countries and partners with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide.

In public records, Hesai Group is a for-profit public company headquartered in Shanghai, trading under the ticker HSAI, with SEC CIK number 0001861737. The available record lists no lawsuits.
